pairs.description: A list of text pairs and their equivalence judgments.

sentence1.description: First biomedical sentence stating a concrete, literature-consistent fact or finding (e.g., mechanism, clinical outcome, or quantitative result).

sentence2.description: Second biomedical sentence on the same domain, phrased as a factual scientific statement suitable for comparison with sentence1.

score.description: BIOSSES-style semantic similarity in [0.0, 4.0], where higher indicates more nearly identical meaning (~4: paraphrase/same claim; ~2: related topic with materially different claim; ~0: unrelated).
